title: Very Heavy thick, sharp, full tang.
text:
Very Heavy thick, sharp, full tang.. Nice looking cleaver knife, full tang. Has a look of distressed steel 3/4 of the knife above the sharp blade.
This is a Very heavy thick butcher knife, I don’t consider this to be a chef knife that
Could be used for a everyday house hold knife. I would rather have a thinner more usable cleaver! Or it’s more for a man!
I used this to cut in half a fresh pineapple, which it did pretty easy, but then I took another 8 in chef knife I got from Amazon that was easier to use, and I think was sharper.
I keep all my knifes sharpened , ready to be used.

This butcher knife is good if your a hunter to cut your meat, or in the kitchen for cutting up ribs, chopping threw joints of knuckle bones, cutting threw roasts , and chickens etc.

That said ,my knife came in with some rust on the distressed part of the knife.
As soon as I’m finished using a knife it’s hand washed and dried. Never put a knife in the dishwasher it will dull your knife from the detergent and can rust your knifes depending on what there made of.

Comes with a hard leather cover.
